newsitem.title: USA: Seragen sells plants to Boston University.
newsitem.headline: Seragen sells plants to Boston University.

text.p: Seragen Inc said it will sell its manufacturing and clinical operations facilities to Boston University for $5 million.
Under the agreement, the facilities will still make Seragen products on a contract basis and provide ongoing administration of clinical and pre-clinical operations, the company said.

The closing of the transaction, which has been approved by both Boston University's and Seragen's boards, is subject to approval by Seragen stockholders. Boston University will start operating the facilities immediately.
